novel_features.name: Framework audit
novel_features.description: Cross-check whether a published video hits the Signal / Belief-Shift / Action-CTA structure by joining retention buckets against script lines from your local content directory.
novel_features.rationale: Requires script binding via content-registry.md and a per-bucket retention store. No other YouTube tool has this join.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent reviews a published video, this is the only command that tells it which structural beat lost the audience.

novel_features.name: Retention curve
novel_features.description: Return the 100-bucket retention curve for a video as JSON or an ASCII sparkline, with the three sharpest drops auto-annotated.
novel_features.rationale: Public Analytics API gives the curve, but only this CLI annotates drops and caches them per recorded_at for compare-over-time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Quickest way for an agent to identify which second of a video lost the audience.

novel_features.name: Retention cohort
novel_features.description: Average retention across videos whose title matches a regex (build-guide cohort vs rework cohort vs tier-list cohort).
novel_features.rationale: Requires FTS on titles plus per-video retention rows in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells an agent whether a content format is structurally stronger than another.

novel_features.name: CTR decay
novel_features.description: Compare first-72h CTR to day-30 CTR for a video; flags fast-decaying thumbnails.
novel_features.rationale: Requires daily impression snapshots; cannot be computed from one API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Identifies which thumbnails earned their early lift and which are dying.

novel_features.name: Watchlist benchmark
novel_features.description: Compare own channel against the watchlist on CTR, retention, or upload cadence — normalized scale across all channels.
novel_features.rationale: Multi-channel normalized schema; competitor data via public Data API joined with own analytics.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent is planning what to publish next, this tells it which axis the channel is losing on.

novel_features.name: Title pattern mining
novel_features.description: Token-level analysis of words/phrases that correlate with above-median CTR (winners) or below-median (losers).
novel_features.rationale: Pure local SQL over per-video CTR + title tokens; no API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Drives an agent's title brainstorm with empirical evidence from this channel.

novel_features.name: Idea gap
novel_features.description: Topics the watchlist covered in the last N days that the own channel has not.
novel_features.rationale: Joins watchlist search snapshots against the own-channel video corpus via FTS.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Cheapest way for an agent to find what's underserved on this channel.

novel_features.name: Watchlist suggest
novel_features.description: Auto-discover competitor channels for the watchlist via Search API; ranks by relevance and recent upload volume.
novel_features.rationale: Combines Data API search + channels.list and applies a relevance heuristic agnostic to incumbents.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Saves an agent from manually curating a competitor list.

novel_features.name: Hybrid quota-aware sync
novel_features.description: Incremental sync of own channel + watchlist with daily-quota budgeting; caps concurrency and prefers cache.
novel_features.rationale: 10K Data API quota/day means search.list calls cost 100 units each. The CLI tracks cumulative spend and skips live calls past budget.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Prevents an agent from accidentally exhausting daily quota with one bad call.

narrative.headline: Every YouTube creator metric that matters, offline-queryable, with framework-audit binding to your scripts. The CLI that turns retention curves into belief-shift evidence.
narrative.value_prop: yt-studio-pp-cli is a hybrid YouTube Data API + Analytics API + Studio Innertube creator-side CLI. It caches channel videos, daily metrics, retention curves, demographics, and thumbnail CTR into a local SQLite. The killer command, framework-audit, joins retention drops to script Signal/Belief-Shift/Action-CTA lines so you have measurable evidence of which structural beat lost the audience.
narrative.auth_narrative: One-time interactive login captures OAuth refresh tokens (Data API + Analytics API, scopes youtube.readonly + yt-analytics.readonly) and the Studio web session cookies. OAuth refresh is automatic on 401. Studio session expiry surfaces as typed exit 4 with a re-login hint. Tokens live in ~/.openclaw/state/yt-studio/ mode 600.

quickstart.comment: One-time interactive: opens browser for OAuth + harvests Studio cookies
Pulls own channel videos + watchlist + daily metrics into local SQLite
Quickest health check; should return your channel stats
ASCII sparkline of the retention curve with 3 sharpest drops auto-annotated
The killer command: joins retention to script structure

troubleshoots.fix: Run `yt-studio-pp-cli login` to refresh OAuth + capture a new Studio session

troubleshoots.symptom: Exit 5 on Studio-dependent commands (real-time, A/B thumbnails)
troubleshoots.fix: Studio Innertube schema drift; run `yt-studio-pp-cli sniff-doctor` for the suspected mismatch, then file an issue
Daily quota exhausted (10K units). Wait until midnight PT or run `--data-source local` until reset
Run `yt-studio-pp-cli script-link <video_id> <script_path>` to manually bind the script, or add a `**Video ID:** <id>` line to ~/.openclaw/workspace/data/content-registry.md
Run `yt-studio-pp-cli sync --full` first; offline FTS needs synced data

narrative.when_to_use: Use yt-studio-pp-cli when an agent needs creator-side analytics: retention curves, per-video CTR, audience demographics, competitor benchmarks, or framework audits against published videos. This is the right tool for post-publish review, content-format ideation, and identifying which video structures earned (or lost) the audience. It is NOT the right tool for downloading videos, fetching transcripts for transcription, or publishing new content — those belong to yt-dlp, Whisper-based MCPs, and the publishing pipeline respectively.

recipes.title: Audit a specific upload
recipes.explanation: Audit a single video against the audience-obsession framework, returning only the verdict, drops, and the three structural lines.

recipes.title: Find a cohort signal
recipes.explanation: Average retention across Rework-series videos in the last 90 days, returning only the cohort size, average retention percentage, and worst bucket.

recipes.title: Title brainstorm with evidence
recipes.explanation: List title tokens with above-15% CTR lift; feeds an agent's title-generation prompt.

recipes.title: Quota-safe morning sync
recipes.explanation: Daily incremental, capped concurrency, with quota usage printed to stderr.

recipes.title: Inspect Studio session health
recipes.explanation: Probes the Studio Innertube session; returns exit 4 if the session has expired (re-run login).
